$comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored) and fill in. apiKey may be omitted when apiKeyEnv names an environment variable that holds it.

openai.$comment: Any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint: DeepSeek, Qwen (DashScope), Kimi, OpenRouter, vLLM, Ollama...

anthropic.$comment: Official Anthropic SDK. fallbacks stays off for benchmarking so a run is never silently served by a different model.

mock.$comment: Offline scripted provider for smoke tests. Each step is either {"tools": [{"name", "input"}]} or {"text": "..."}.

memoryAnchor.$comment: root: MemoryAnchor checkout whose dist/ is used (default: parent of MA-mini-agent). Run `npm run build` there first.
